title: Rule out two entry interfaces for helper 544
body:
## Summary

- Test a second staged entrance that would narrow helper 544 from width 7 to 6. A short target-frame obstruction excludes every scalar frame refit of the unchanged release word on both actual PR4076 providers.
- Construct an exact five-source dirty recovery and ten-gate late release, with literal inverse cleanup. It passes complete operator checks but fails frames; a written invariant excludes any scalar-only recovery block at that cut with the same following consumer.
- Include a separately implemented constraint certificate, meaningful rejection controls and an explicitly hypothetical complete pooled-cost screen.

## Scope and limits

Two pinned finite words, arbitrary dirty inputs, and written implications for all monotone scalar frames or scalar-only blocks under the declared boundary premises. The late block may use independent dirty scratch, but no new native map/reset. Different cuts, consumers, producer/target contracts and entrance directions outside the inherited producer frame remain open.

The positive construction target is not achieved. No candidate paid profile, physical supplier, native-phase/owner/source-window/precision/tape/all-size/outer admission, formal-kernel proof or kappa improvement is established. The pooled saving depends on a hypothetical local signature that these interfaces cannot admit.

## Test plan

Tested commit: `d75583e6f25a8ce34aad1463903c6be03c409dd1`.

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/second-staged-544` — both public checkers; 723-input forward/dual/inverse checks including 91 dirty buffers, separate 632-column formal-operator prefix check, a 127-space entrance census with one eligible space, and 25 independent controls.
- [x] Four fresh source-bound normal/optimized mathematical stages, exactly matching the committed certificates; separate AI mathematical cross-review passed.
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/second-staged-544 --check-source-history` — all 25 committed package/input files and retained source ancestry. Official export/integrity passes; both public commands also pass normally and under `-O` in a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH and unchanged files. Its local driver is orchestration only, not a private mathematical checker.
- [x] Natural [CI39310970822](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39310970822) completed successfully on the exact tested commit: plan and registered package replay. No rerun or dispatch requested.
- [ ] Independent human review — not observed; AI checks are not human or proof-kernel acceptance.
